title: A member account
description: A member account of the organisation, named for the file: its IAM alias, root email and every layer's key for it.

name.description: Its display name in Organizations, which every layer finds it by.

organizational_unit.description: The OU it's in, by path: its controls. An account can move; an OU can't.

owner.description: The team whose layers it holds, which administers it outside Deployments.
